en: A colorized historic postcard view of a large Renaissance-style hunting palace enclosing a wide courtyard. The multi-storey buildings have light-colored facades, steep red-tiled roofs, several gabled dormers, and a clock or bell tower on the right. Ivy climbs up much of the lower walls, and a large tree stands in the middle of the courtyard under a blue sky with scattered clouds. At the top of the image there is German text printed in a serif font.
